name: Evoq Finance
rootCause: Evoq Finance suffered a $420,000 loss on BNB Chain after an attacker compromised the owner’s private key, transferred contract ownership, and upgraded to malicious logic. Industry reports explain the method, but no official technical postmortem, transaction hash, or fund flow is available. The attack was enabled by compromise of Evoq Finance’s owner private key, allowing transfer of contract ownership and deployment of a malicious upgrade. Exact technical cause and forensic chain evidence remain absent.
